declarations.fn2-pool:
(defcolumns fn2-pool
  ((gen :u60) (base :u60) (cap :u32)
   (state (:enum fn2-pool-state (:free :workspace :leased-in :leased-out :handed :retired)))
   (owner-kind :u8) (owner-slot :u32) (owner-gen :u60)
   (lease-op-slot :link) (lease-op-gen :u60) (lease-off :u32) (lease-len :u32)
   (out-count :u32) (query-ref-count :u60) (fill :u32)
   (hand-to-kind :u8) (hand-to-slot :link) (hand-to-gen :u60)
   (next-free :link) (class :u8)
   (credit-group :link) (credit-nonce :u60)
   (credit-owner-kind :u8) (credit-owner-slot :u32) (credit-owner-gen :u60))
  :rows-bound 4294967296
  :init-name fn2-pool-columns-init
  :extra-fields
  ((fn2-pool-data :type (array (unsigned-byte 8) (0)) :initially 0 :resizable t :why "Byte backing store, addressed by each slot base and capacity.")
   (fn2-pool-class-heads :type (array (unsigned-byte 32) (16)) :initially *fn2-none* :why "One free-chain head per size class, not per slot.")
   (fn2-pool-class-counts :type (array (unsigned-byte 32) (16)) :initially 0 :why "Free capacity is counted by size class.")
   (fn2-pool-class-sizes :type (array (unsigned-byte 32) (16)) :initially 0 :why "Class geometry has a different cardinality from slots.")
   (fn2-pool-nclasses :type (integer 0 16) :initially 0 :why "Number of configured size classes governs class-array access.")
   (fn2-pool-gen-limit :type (unsigned-byte 60) :initially 0 :why "A single retirement limit applies to all pool slots.")

   (fn2-pool-credit-configured :type (integer 0 1) :initially 0 :why "Credit geometry is established only at initialization.")
   (fn2-pool-credit-group-count :type (unsigned-byte 32) :initially 0 :why "One working group and actual ordinary commit-row drain groups.")
   (fn2-pool-credit-protected :type (array (unsigned-byte 32) (0)) :initially 0 :resizable t :why "Profile-derived credit accounting; protected is per class, demand/available per group and class.")
   (fn2-pool-credit-purpose :type (array (unsigned-byte 8) (0)) :initially 0 :resizable t :why "Profile-derived credit accounting; protected is per class, demand/available per group and class.")
   (fn2-pool-credit-phase :type (array (unsigned-byte 8) (0)) :initially 0 :resizable t :why "Profile-derived credit accounting; protected is per class, demand/available per group and class.")
   (fn2-pool-credit-group-nonce :type (array (unsigned-byte 60) (0)) :initially 0 :resizable t :why "Profile-derived credit accounting; protected is per class, demand/available per group and class.")
   (fn2-pool-credit-group-owner-kind :type (array (unsigned-byte 8) (0)) :initially 0 :resizable t :why "Profile-derived credit accounting; protected is per class, demand/available per group and class.")
   (fn2-pool-credit-group-owner-slot :type (array (unsigned-byte 32) (0)) :initially 0 :resizable t :why "Profile-derived credit accounting; protected is per class, demand/available per group and class.")
   (fn2-pool-credit-group-owner-gen :type (array (unsigned-byte 60) (0)) :initially 0 :resizable t :why "Profile-derived credit accounting; protected is per class, demand/available per group and class.")
   (fn2-pool-credit-demand :type (array (unsigned-byte 32) (0)) :initially 0 :resizable t :why "Profile-derived credit accounting; protected is per class, demand/available per group and class.")
   (fn2-pool-credit-available :type (array (unsigned-byte 32) (0)) :initially 0 :resizable t :why "Profile-derived credit accounting; protected is per class, demand/available per group and class.")
   (fn2-pool-retired-count :type (unsigned-byte 32) :initially 0 :why "Aggregate retired capacity survives slot reuse.")))

declarations.fn2-run-installed:
(defcolumns fn2-run-installed
 ((state (:enum fn2-run-installed-state (:free :live :retired)))
  (schema :u60) (run :u60) (wire-run :u60) (top :u8) (slot :u32) (gen :u60) (unit :u60) (counter :u60) (entries :u60)
  (okind :u8) (oslot :u32) (ogen :u60) (filter :bool) (funit :u60) (fcounter :u60) (ufirst :u60) (ulast :u60)
  ;; Resident runs use their pool lease; selected checkpoint sources load by Ref.
  (physical :bool) (epoch :u60) (catalog-tag :u60)
  (hash-0 :u32) (hash-1 :u32) (hash-2 :u32) (hash-3 :u32)
  (hash-4 :u32) (hash-5 :u32) (hash-6 :u32) (hash-7 :u32))
 :extra-fields ((fn2-run-installed-physical-count :type (unsigned-byte 32) :initially 0
 :why "All nonFREE physical installed rows, maintained by shared install/free transitions; not catalog-local or a caller readiness flag.")))
